reference_prompts: Pinned upstream task templates in upstream/; LOONG original per-row templates in loong_templates.json; BABILong vendored task prompts
longmemeval_scoring: Official question-type/abstention prompts, temperature 0, max_tokens 10; reject malformed judgments
loong_scoring: Exact original rubric; adapted pinned judge, reasoning_effort none, output cap 512. Perfect Rate requires score exactly 100; mean score also reported.
nolima_scoring: Official case-sensitive contains metric on the paper's frozen diagnostic subset, not official base-length-normalized NoLiMa
judge_reuse: Identical question, gold answer and reader response reuse one cached judgment; no independent judge-repeat uncertainty is claimed.
latency: Fresh online pass on 30 prespecified matched questions per cell, one seed 5768, concurrency 8; selector measured with fresh data caches at all three seeds; cold model load separate
failure_policy: Missing answers are incorrect in full-cohort coverage reports; malformed or unavailable judges remain explicitly unresolved rather than silently omitted
budget_note: All requests reserve native-count-based maximum reader charges. Transient or metadata-incomplete streams have at most eight attempts with shared backoff. Previous uncertain reservations remain counted toward the cap. Experiment billing differs from hypothetical uncached per-query list-price serving cost.
